card.title: Practice with AI
card.desc: Talk to a tutor about the lesson, like a call. The tutor asks, you answer out loud, and you get feedback tied to the video after every question.

intro.heading: Chat with a tutor about this lesson
intro.desc: The tutor talks to you live about the people and events in the video, like a call. Answer in English; the tutor checks your answer against the transcript and asks the next question. You can interrupt the tutor any time.
intro.ruleTime: Up to 15 minutes, then the tutor wraps up
intro.ruleCredit: Each conversation costs a fixed amount, charged once when the tutor speaks the first question; hints and history are free
intro.ruleWatch: Watch the video once before you start
intro.starting: The tutor is preparing a question…
intro.ruleMic: Needs microphone access; leaving the page or pressing Finish ends the conversation (it cannot be resumed)

bar.question: Question {{n}}/{{max}}
bar.finishNeedAnswer: Answer at least one question before finishing

thread.better: A more natural way to say it
thread.label: Conversation

summary.title: Overall feedback
summary.expired: The 15 minutes are up, so the tutor wrapped up the conversation.
summary.stopped: This conversation stopped midway, so it has no overall feedback.
summary.failed: The overall feedback could not be created.

history.title: Conversation history
history.empty: You have no conversations for this lesson yet.
history.reviewing: You are reviewing an old conversation (read only, no credits used).

video.title: Rewatch the video
video.hint: The transcript is hidden so you answer on your own.

errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You don't have enough credits to start. Free credits refresh tomorrow; Pro credits refresh in your next plan month.
errors.AI_CHAT_ANSWER_INVALID: Your answer must be 1 to 1000 characters.
errors.AI_FEEDBACK_BUSY: The AI is busy, try again in a few minutes. No credits were used.
errors.AI_FEEDBACK_UNAVAILABLE: The tutor is temporarily unavailable. No credits were used, please try again later.
errors.AI_CHAT_TURN_CONFLICT: This question was just answered elsewhere. The conversation was reloaded.
errors.AI_CHAT_FINISH_TOO_EARLY: Answer at least one question before finishing.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Connection lost. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong, please try again.
errors.AI_CHAT_LIVE_UNAVAILABLE: The voice tutor is unavailable right now. You were not charged; try again or use text chat.
errors.AI_CHAT_QUESTION_LIMIT: This conversation already has all its questions.
errors.MIC_UNAVAILABLE: The microphone is not available. Allow it for this page or use text chat.
errors.START_TIMEOUT: The tutor did not answer in time. You were not charged; try again.
errors.CONNECT_ERROR: Could not connect to the voice tutor. You were not charged; try again or use text chat.
errors.CONNECTION_CLOSED: The connection to the tutor dropped. You were not charged; try again.

live.micNote: Allow the microphone when your browser asks. You are not charged until the tutor speaks the first question.
live.summarizing: The tutor is writing the overall review…
live.fallbackGeneric: Could not connect to the voice tutor. You were not charged.
live.playingClip: Replaying a part of the video
live.replayHint: Replay the part of the video this question is about (free, once per question)

qa.title: Q&A
qa.desc: The tutor asks about details in the video, then digs deeper into what you say.

interview.title: Interview
interview.desc: You play a person from the video and the tutor interviews you as a reporter.

retell.title: Retell
retell.desc: The tutor pretends not to have seen the video; you retell it and the tutor asks about what is missing.
